description: This is a test class for the SingleSelectionAddOnsBrowserFragment in the AnySoftKeyboard project. It contains unit tests verifying UI components, layout configurations, and menu options related to the add-ons browser fragment, using Robolectric for Android testing.

classes.name: SingleSelectionAddOnsBrowserFragmentTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying the UI and behavior of the SingleSelectionAddOnsBrowserFragment in the AnySoftKeyboard project.

methods.name: testHasDemoKeyboardView
methods.description: Verifies that the demo keyboard view is present and visible in the fragment.

methods.name: testHasDemoKeyboardViewInLandscape
methods.description: Verifies the demo keyboard view in a landscape configuration.

methods.name: testDemoKeyboardShowsLastUsedKeyboardAlphabet
methods.description: Tests that the demo keyboard shows the last used alphabet keyboard (currently ignored).

methods.name: testDemoKeyboardShowsLastUsedKeyboardSymbols
methods.description: Tests that the demo keyboard shows the last used symbols keyboard (currently ignored).

methods.name: testHasListShadow
methods.description: Verifies the presence and correct shadow resource of the list foreground.

methods.name: testHasListShadowInLandscape
methods.description: Verifies the list shadow resource in landscape configuration.

methods.name: testRootIsVertical
methods.description: Checks that the root layout is a vertical LinearLayout.

methods.name: testRootIsHorizontalInLandscape
methods.description: Checks that the root layout is a horizontal LinearLayout in landscape.

methods.name: testLayoutIsNotWeightedInPortrait
methods.description: Verifies layout parameters in portrait orientation.

methods.name: testLayoutIsWeightedInLandscape
methods.description: Verifies layout parameters in landscape orientation.

methods.name: testHasTweaksAndMarket
methods.description: Checks that menu options for tweaks and market are visible.
